entities.summary: Lola Islamovna Karimova-Tillyaeva is an Uzbek diplomat and the daughter of Islam Karimov the former President of Uzbekistan and his wife, Tatyana Akbarovna Karimova. In 2012 she and her ex-husband, Timur Tillyaev, made it into Bilan magazine's list of Switzerland's 300 richest residents. Her older sister is business mogul Gulnara Karimova.
